approval_scope: Original static scene assets and local metadata semantics only. Approval does not qualify physical hardware, electrical/thermal behavior, experiment replication or source-conflict resolution. Final archive refreeze must contain these reviewed author bytes plus final reviewer reports and a regenerated manifest.
review_basis: Published transistor_operations_v2 task and completed source-to-asset audit; not a new independent adjudication of the source paper.

findings.description: Initial bindings lacked explicit source station IDs and composite handoff relationships.
findings.resolution: Six exact source station IDs resolve to existing inventory objects; separate HIGHK, THERMAL, LONG_TERM and STRUCTURAL constraints preserve closed-service and custody boundaries.

checks.source_snapshot: Five original published-task hashes match; layer, netlist and conflict payloads are exact copies
checks.operations: 44 exact unique operation IDs, matching kinds, each with one primary group and physical_execution false
checks.stations: All six published station IDs resolve, separately from six semantic asset groups
checks.native_geometry: 72 mesh laminae; Si 525 um, SiO2 2 um, 60 active layers in exact order, nine 50 nm reference buffers and one 50 nm reference cap; 528.7 um total
checks.native_scope: Unpatterned 20 mm authored lateral envelopes; all native layers declare no connectivity and no fabrication execution; C01 execution defaults remain null
checks.display_separation: 72 distinct display bars, 3 mm each, 1.5 mm gaps, explicitly no uniform scale factor; no native laminae in either GLB
checks.conflict_gates: All ten C01-C10 remain unresolved blocking qualifications after any acknowledgement
checks.netlists: Ordinary Fig4 and independent S31 are distinct and exact; VTG1 and VTG2 remain separate; unmapped parallel topology rejected
checks.metadata_semantics: 180 full pair/netlist lifecycles; wrong-type rejection on every binding field; consumed continuity non-replay; all 44 physical operations rejected through both interfaces after acknowledgements
checks.reuse: 15 exact AFM source meshes from two families; source Blend digest matches; final scene vertices/faces/transforms checked; zero new unique credit
checks.portable_imports: Both final GLBs independently imported into clean Blender 4.3.2, with no images, textures, external resources, required extensions or native scientific layer meshes
checks.visual_evidence: All three final 1600x1100 CPU Cycles 96-sample images directly inspected; clear closed-service/no-data/unknown-safe-state warnings; metric ruler and retained sample/PCB handoffs visible
checks.provenance_boundary: Generator uses original generic primitives, font labels and licensed original reuse; native file has no linked libraries or packed source images; GLBs have no image/texture resources
checks.candidate_export: 38 exact regular-file members; 37 manifest digests verify; no duplicates, path traversal, unexpected files or forbidden source artifacts

candidate_archive_inspection.reviewer_reports_at_candidate_time: pending/first-build reviewer outputs were intentionally replaced after candidate inspection; no author payload changed

archive_refreeze_rule: Final ZIP digest and exact member-byte equivalence are verified outside this archive after the final review is saved, avoiding recursive archive/self-hashes. Do not reuse the candidate digest as final.
limitations: Caller-owned synthetic observations provide no authentication or real safe-zero/continuity evidence
No voltage/current/temperature/measurement output or physical service is implemented
No exact active-device CAD, masks, pad map, collision, contact, calibration or robot reachability qualification
All ten source conflicts remain unresolved; source population counts and elapsed experiments are not recreated
Review author hashes exclude MANIFEST.sha256 and reviewer reports to avoid self-reference; the final manifest must hash all 37 non-manifest members
